format: Published, canonically unallocated R0044 bounded documentary comparison v1
scope: One actual matched public-source qualification comparison, with parent documentary receiving. No native JOIN, owner approval, campaign credit or statistical effectiveness verdict.
real_task_and_consumer: Qualify the exact public EMAS reconstruction for the issue-owned maintainer candidate; root executor actually receives the report and uses its source/guard/action/findings in candidate documentation.

topology.decomposed: two fresh member/relation contexts concurrently plus actual root integration
topology.participant_spawned_agents: none authorised; no such action reported

capabilities: Same complete frozen checkout, public source and issue/receiving files, read-only source access and own-output writes; efficient scripts and parallel independent tool calls available to every participant. No locality/right constraint makes the direct route infeasible.

direct.timing_limit: Reported interval and parent observation are distinct; final serialization, routing and observation delay are not active worker compute.

members.scope: Partial contribution; combined receipt is required
members.timing_limit: Reported interval and parent observation are distinct; final serialization, routing and observation delay are not active worker compute.

relations.scope: Partial contribution; combined receipt is required
relations.timing_limit: One preliminary bootstrap read preceded local logging; its interval is unknown. Parent dispatch bounds the larger elapsed observation.

complete_alternatives.outcome_comparison: Both complete required documentary alternatives received

observable_message_bytes.limit: Bytes are not model tokens; exact operational messages are retained in the return archive.

cost_partitions.common_preparation: Source recovery, candidate authoring, input/protocol/oracle preparation and initial focused checks are common fixed work. Complete active time/tokens/money were not exposed; known command timings and retained failures are in the return.
cost_partitions.receiver_harness_rework: Initial direct receiving rejected extra member annotations through overstrict whole-object equality. Required-field correction preserves the unchanged frozen facts/schema interpretation and is applied identically to both alternatives; old failure and discriminating controls retained. Direct end-to-end observation includes this interval; it is also identified as common receiver setup/rework, not worker compute.
cost_partitions.recurring_execution: Use each dispatch/return/receiving observation and separately reported worker interval; summed overlapping intervals are not elapsed or active-compute time.
cost_partitions.split_rework: Member participant retained a missing COMPOSED profile expansion and corrected source-closure control, plus an inventory quoting deviation that exposed only non-frozen filenames. Relation participant retained locator-object/expanded-record mismatch and a pre-logging bootstrap limit. Parent supplemental raw-ZIP selector initially required a slash before a root-level member; corrected source selection and failure remain separate from participant results.
cost_partitions.final_lifecycle_work: Shared code review, source navigation repair, package/portal/copy qualification, publication and recovery delivery are separate subsequent work recorded in the return. They are not zero or a complete task bill for either alternative.

receiving_controls.meaning: Actual documentary packets plus explicitly constructed incomplete/corrupt/cheap-path controls. Presence flags and echoed owner text do not authenticate rights or native receiving; all actual positive packets retain pending native JOIN.

source_transition.finding: EAA host comment 6204277607 belongs under issue232, not233. Retain the old failure and exact bound comment. All 76 rows and incident facts are unchanged; participants did not qualify the later repaired navigation.
source_transition.independent_review: One fresh source reviewer also reproduced the defect and full-source correspondence, then reviews the final whole-candidate delta with this prior exposure disclosed.

limitations: Same model family, host/filesystem/cache and original sources create common causes; distinct contexts are not statistical independence.
The direct arm ran first. Parent preparation and the separate source review overlapped parts of the shared host; platform/cache/load effects were not controlled or measured.
Parent has authoring context. Participant read/command reports are retained but are not complete independently authenticated model/native transcripts.
Reported finish times can precede final serialization/return; dispatch-to-return observations include routing, serialization and observation delay.
Unknown material costs prevent a full total-cost ranking. No measured dimension alone establishes comparative causation, a general autonomy result or a global CBAL optimum.
The adequate direct path remains available. One selected task does not qualify all 76 mechanisms, all32groups or the sibling/host acceptance predicates.
Later sealed target/primary routing/private residuals and complete native/owner receiving remain pending; older public/EAA-side evidence is not their substitute.
total_cost_conclusion: INCONCLUSIVE: compare only the explicitly observed dimensions; preserve both successful documentary arrangements and all failures/rework without a total-cost or general multi-agent superiority claim.

current_applicability.scope: Separate final-target continuation; no original experiment replay or rebinding.
current_applicability.selected_acceptance: Exact final human decision must expressly accept the documentary scope and retain operational/native residuals.
current_applicability.final_target_receiving: Separately observed receiver and independent review, bound in the issue certificate; original participants do not qualify later target fields.
current_applicability.later_costs: Continuation receiving/review/recovery/qualification/delivery are separate costs; tokens, money and active compute remain unmeasured.
